propositions: Every LLM call in code-review gate executes on cfg.model regardless of per-step model declarations, despite all five steps declaring model classes in code-review.yaml
PydanticAIRunner.run ignores req.config.model and resolves from its own constructor config (self._config), discarding the per-step model routed by RunnerAgentStep
Usage log records op (prompt name) but not step id, preventing attribution of calls like code-review-base (used by both base step and batch finder) to their originating step
The gateway step passes per-step resolved models into RunRequest.config but the runner layer does not consult it, breaking declarations for single-shot prompt steps and batch steps alike
Fix requires both observability (Step 0: ContextVar carrying step id and declared model class token) and wiring (runner layer respecting req.config.model override)
